title: BattleFrame: Simple Skirmish
description: Simple Skirmish ruleset for the BattleFrame system. An implementation of Simple Fantasy Skirmish by Peter Vodden (https://petervodden.blog), licensed CC BY-NC 4.0 (Attribution, Non-Commercial). This module is free and must not be sold. It implements the Basic Game mechanics; it ships no artwork.
